items.q: What is the Calculators suite on Zetawala?
items.a: It is a suite of 18 free deterministic calculators for freelancers, SaaS founders, marketers, and ecommerce sellers. Every result is computed from formulas in the browser—no LLM calls.
No. All math runs locally from your inputs. AI provider rates in the API cost calculator are published estimate tables only.

items.q: Which calculator should I start with?
items.a: Freelancers should start with the Hourly Rate or Project Pricing calculator. SaaS founders often begin with SaaS Pricing, LTV, and CAC. Sellers should open Ecommerce, Amazon FBA, Etsy, or eBay profit tools.
They are transparent estimates from standard business formulas. Always verify fees, tax rules, and ad metrics with your own accounts.
